ValidationRule.description: INACTIVE (8 Sep 2026): standard Division keeps the CRM business-unit taxonomy (57 report filters, ChurnZero formula); Workday division is written to Workday_Division__c. Kept for a possible future merge.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Division ) ), NOT( $Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c ), CASE( Division, "Commercial", 1, "Content and Editorial", 1, "Product & Technology", 1, "Operations Finance", 1, "Corporate Strategy", 1, "Operations", 1, "Operations People & Culture", 1, "Corporate Executive", 1, "Executive Office", 1, 0 ) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Division must be one of the nine Workday divisions (see the field help). It is maintained by the Workday sync: correct the value in Workday.
